_comment: The one table of WooCommerce selectors the Cart and Checkout look settings paint. Read by includes/woocommerce/commerce-look/selectors.php (the writer) and scripts/computed-route/lib/site-check-commerce-look.mjs (the drift probe). Selectors are read from the DOM WooCommerce renders on wc_version, never guessed. cart / checkout: selector list relative to the block root (a missing key means the row does not apply to that block; no comma inside a functional pseudo-class). state: prose. needs: machine-readable state for the probe (basket filled; viewport any|wide|narrow; action none|open-coupon-on-cart|tick-order-note|optional). columns: the property kinds a row can take (attribute suffixes, CSS property, inspector control kind); a row's `columns` list names the extra settings it carries, its attribute names are the row prefix plus the column suffix (`prefix` overrides the row id), generated into src/blocks/extensions/commerce-look/attributes-table.generated.js and the extension roster by scripts/generate-commerce-look-table.js, printed by includes/woocommerce/commerce-look/table.php and drawn by src/blocks/extensions/commerce-look/table-panels.js. `label` names the row in the inspector; `probe: false` leaves a row out of the selector-drift probe. `root_repeat`: how many times the scope class leads the row's selectors when its settings print (default 1); a row whose WooCommerce rule carries three classes or more sets 3 so the setting wins on specificity at every width and state, not on stylesheet order.

coupon_apply.state: basket filled; any user; any width; the coupon Apply button (the coupon panel open)
